full_prompt_en: A detailed historical-style painting shows three seated figures on a stone terrace with a large white-and-brown dog standing before them. At the left, a bearded man in a dark violet and ochre robe leans forward; beside him, a woman in a flowing ivory dress turns toward an older figure in an elaborate rust-orange garment and patterned cap. The older figure holds a hand near the face, as though pausing in thought. The dog stands at the right, its head lowered and body angled toward the viewer, giving the human group a quiet point of attention. Behind them, a wall of decorative stonework and faded painted motifs occupies the left side, while green hills and a low bridge open into distance at the upper right. Robes fall in carefully observed folds across pale steps, and small patches of grass break the stone floor in the foreground. The palette is muted and earthy: cream, sandstone, moss green, rust, faded blue, and deep violet. Fine line and layered, slightly granular color describe embroidery, masonry, fur, and distant terrain. Light is soft and overcast, keeping every element readable without sharp shadows. The composition moves from the dense seated group to the animal and then outward into the landscape. The whole frame feels contemplative and antiquarian, as if a quiet narrative had been preserved in a timeworn illuminated panel.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅细致的历史风格绘画描绘三个人坐在石台上，一只棕白相间的大狗站在面前。左侧一名穿深紫与赭黄长袍的胡须男子向前倾身；他旁边一位穿飘垂象牙白长裙的女子转向一名披繁复锈橙色衣袍、戴花纹帽的年长者。年长者将手靠近脸，仿佛停下思索。狗立在右侧，低着头，身体向观者倾斜，成为人群安静注视的一点。后方左侧是一面带装饰石工和褪色绘制纹样的墙，右上角则敞向绿色山丘与低桥。衣袍以仔细观察的褶皱垂落在浅色台阶上，前景石面由小块草地打断。色盘低饱和且有土地气息：奶油色、砂岩色、苔绿、锈色、褪色蓝和深紫。细线与层叠、略带颗粒的色彩描写刺绣、石工、皮毛和远处地形。光线柔和如阴天，没有锋利阴影，却让每种元素仍可辨认。构图从密集坐者转向动物，再向外进入风景。整幅画沉思而有古物气质，仿佛一段安静叙事被保存在经岁月磨旧的彩绘板中。
style_prompt_en: The historical-style painted image uses fine contours, layered muted color, and a softly granular aged surface. Ivory, sandstone, rust, moss green, faded blue, and deep violet build a restrained earth palette. Dense patterned passages sit beside broad pale drapery-like planes; small green accents punctuate the lower ground. Background ornament and distant terrain are carefully present but softened enough to leave the foreground group dominant. Edges are mostly clear yet never sharp, as if pigment has settled into worn paper or plaster. Fine repetitive marks describe embroidery, stone, fur, and foliage, while larger folds create a slower visual rhythm. Diffuse overcast light keeps values close and shadows shallow. A broad cluster on one side is balanced by an open lateral extension and recession into the upper distance. The whole frame feels contemplative, narrative, and antiquarian through patient detail and time-softened color.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅历史风格绘画图像使用纤细轮廓、层叠低饱和色彩和柔和颗粒的旧化表面。象牙白、砂岩色、锈色、苔绿、褪色蓝和深紫构成克制的土地色盘。密集纹样区域与宽阔浅色、近似垂布的平面并置；细小绿色重点点在下部地面。背景装饰和远处地形被仔细保留，却足够柔和，使前景组合保持主导。边缘大多清楚，却绝不锋利，仿佛颜料已经沉入旧纸或灰泥。细小重复笔迹描写刺绣、石材、皮毛与枝叶，较大的褶线创造更慢的视觉节奏。阴天般的漫射光让明度接近、阴影浅淡。一侧宽阔的形体簇群由横向开放的延伸和向上远处的后退空间平衡。整幅画因耐心细节和被时间柔化的色彩而显得沉思、有叙事感与古物气息。
theme_en: Three seated figures and a dog in an old courtyard
theme_zh: 旧庭院中的三位坐者与一只狗
name: Henry Roderick Newman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
